named_joints = [
    {'name': 'joint1', 'type': 'hinge', 'axis': [0,0,1], 'ctrlrange': [-2.618, 2.618]},

    {'name': 'joint6', 'type': 'hinge', 'axis': [0,0,1], 'ctrlrange': [-3.14, 3.14]},
    {'name': 'joint7', 'type': 'slide', 'axis': [0,0,-1], 'ctrlrange': [0.0, 0.035]},
    {'name': 'joint8', 'type': 'slide', 'axis': [0,0,1], 'ctrlrange': [-0.035, 0.0]},
]
# joint7 and joint8 are finger slide joints (class="finger" -> type=slide)
# joint8 is coupled to joint7 via equality constraint (mirror)
# 6 arm hinge joints + 1 gripper actuator (joint7, joint8 coupled) = 6 arm DOF + 1 gripper = 7 total joints
# Actuated independently: joint1-6 (arm) + gripper (joint7, joint8 coupled) = 7 actuators

print("Arm joints (hinge): joint1-joint6 = 6")
print("Finger joints (slide): joint7, joint8 = 2 (but coupled, 1 actuator)")
print("Total actuators: 7 (joint1-6 + gripper)")
print("Classification: single fixed-base serial arm with parallel-jaw gripper => 'arm'")
print("DOF (actuated): 7")
